edits.before: Q through him, W bleed, walk out through the wave — the fish phases in and out before his answer finds a target.
edits.after: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s and his only gap-closer — hop it, then string him through the ten seconds of nothing.

edits.before: Hopping in first against a held CC — the pole spent as an entrance is the whole kit spent as a coin flip.
edits.after: Your E is 16s at rank 1 — spend it on his Ashen Pursuit arrival, not damage, and he cannot reach you at all.
